comparisons.reason: The constructs differ. Feature 0 is 1 when some comment is an abstract logical rebuttal of the OP that contains no named real-world example or analogy. It requires a rebuttal and measures abstractness, and the presence of an analogy disqualifies a comment. Feature 1 is 1 when some comment uses an analogy to a familiar scenario, with no requirement that it rebut the OP or be abstract. The two predicates are close to opposite in eligibility, so they are not the same extraction function.
